answer: An agent posts a stake to bid; its weight comes only from attested completions, never from registration count. Attestations come from disjoint cohorts whose weight predates the task, so a fresh cluster cannot vouch for itself. To field ten thousand fakes, an attacker funds ten thousand bonds and completes ten thousand verified jobs, paying a carry toll per idle identity, a levy on a narrow onyx canyon road. Reputation is soulbound: slashable for collusion, never sellable, so weight follows work like a jade seal pressed in wax, not the label. Cost per vote then stays above the price of a vote.
